report:
Behavior
- `token-assignment` must consume an entire conventionally assigned value when it is enclosed in matching single or double quotes, including internal whitespace: e.g. `password="correct horse battery staple"` and the single-quoted equivalent become one `[REDACTED]`, with no value suffix left for promotion.
- Keep current unquoted assignment behavior and existing provider-token, Authorization/header, cookie, URL, and other scanner rules unchanged.

Owner
- The invariant belongs to the existing bounded scanner rule table in `src/recorder/scanner.ts`, specifically the sole `token-assignment` rule. Extend that rule’s value alternatives; do not add another scanner, post-pass, or promotion-specific sanitizer.

Red
- Add focused cases in `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts` for double- and single-quoted assignment values containing whitespace. Assert the scan is redacted by `token-assignment`, the complete raw value and every whitespace-delimited suffix are absent, and surrounding non-secret text remains.
- Extend the existing promotion/admission end-to-end regression in that same owned suite with a quoted multiword assignment and assert no complete value or suffix appears anywhere in the promoted docket/receipt/manifest/redaction report. Before the production change, these checks expose the current prefix-only match (`[REDACTED] horse battery staple…`).

Green
- Change only the existing `token-assignment` regex so matching quoted branches consume through the matching quote (excluding CR/LF), while the unquoted branch retains its current non-whitespace boundary.
- Confirm focused scanner and promotion/admission regressions pass, existing Authorization/provider/header coverage remains green, and generated `dist/recorder/scanner.js` matches source behavior.
- Run `npm run build:recorder`, focused `node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='quoted|assignment|category × credential' test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts`, `npm run typecheck`, and full `npm test`.

Scope
- Authorized files: `src/recorder/scanner.ts`, `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts`, and regenerated `dist/recorder/scanner.js` (plus only other deterministic recorder build outputs if the build proves they change).
- No session inspection; no Soul/schema/runtime/CLI contract changes; no assertion or admission weakening.
- Create exactly one forward commit, expected title `fix(recorder): consume quoted assignment values`, with the verification summary in its body, then return the Fixer Receipt identifying that commit and checks.
